page.overview:
Who is Kiri and Ankha?

Kiri and Ankha are characters featured in the television show Mortal Kombat: Conquest. They are portrayed as two female reptiles, similar to that of Khameleon. They are portrayed by Sung Hi Lee (Kiri) and Tahitia Hicks (Ankha).

Kiri and Ankha descend from race of Saurian - reptilian creatures with shapeshifting abilities, and were born in realm of Zaterra. They are two of the few survivors of Zaterra after Shao Kahn invaded it and made it part of Outworld. They became Shao Khan's servants eventually due to lack of choice.

Shao Kahn ordered Kiri and Ankha to eliminate Kung Lao. Rather than confronting him through brute force, the two women devised a far more cunning plan. Together, they manipulated Siro into believing that Kiri was a gifted seer capable of granting him the one thing he desired most: fighting abilities surpassing even Kung Lao’s. Consumed by ambition and his need to prove himself, Siro — accompanied by Taja — visited the House of the Falcon, Kiri’s supposed place of divination in Zhu Zin.

Inside the establishment, Kiri carefully played her role. Pretending to use supernatural insight, she told Siro of ancient ruins buried beneath Zhu Zin — remnants of a forgotten city that concealed a hidden chamber guarded by two mystical warriors. According to her, whoever defeated them would inherit their immense power. To Siro, it sounded like the perfect opportunity. Despite Taja’s open skepticism, he accepted a talisman from Kiri, said to guide him to the chamber and help fulfill his destiny. Throughout the meeting, Ankha grew increasingly irritated by Taja’s refusal to believe Kiri’s story, fearing she might interfere with their scheme. Yet Kiri’s performance left a deep impression on Siro. By the time he left, he trusted Kiri completely and had begun dismissing Taja’s doubts.
